title: Supermarket Chain Suspends Live Facial Recognition Scanners After AI Wrongly Brands Customer a Shoplifter
description: Sainsbury's has paused live facial recognition scanners at its East Dulwich branch after Facewatch software wrongly flagged a loyal customer as a shoplifter.
